name: Transdermal oxybutynin dose-ranging trial
question: Does transdermal oxybutynin reduce urge or mixed urinary incontinence compared with placebo in adults with overactive bladder?

design.population: Adults with overactive bladder and urge or mixed urinary incontinence after symptom stabilization or treatment withdrawal.
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Purpose and Materials and Methods

verdictNote: Rank analysis favored 3.9 mg/day; protocol-specified parametric ANCOVA did not.
takeaway: In 520 randomized adults (515 analyzed) with urge or mixed incontinence, transdermal oxybutynin 3.9 mg/day reduced median weekly leakage more than placebo at 12 weeks (P=0.0165), but the prespecified parametric analysis was nonsignificant (P=0.2831); neither lower dose significantly reduced weekly leakage.

reports.label: Dose-ranging randomized report
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation and Crossref publication month: August 2002; day approximated
reports.citation: Dmochowski RR, Davila GW, Zinner NR, et al. "Efficacy and safety of transdermal oxybutynin in patients with urge and mixed urinary incontinence." *J Urol.* 2002;168(2):580-586. doi:10.1016/S0022-5347(05)64684-8
reports.followUp: 12 weeks blinded, followed by 12 weeks open-label dose titration

results.measure: Median change in weekly incontinence episodes at 12 weeks
results.note: The rank analysis was significant (P=0.0165); protocol-specified parametric ANCOVA was not (P=0.2831). A corrected FDA reanalysis was significant (P=0.0265).
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Results; FDA statistical review, pp. 7-11 (https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2003/21-351_Oxytrol_statr.PDF)

results.measure: Mean change in daily voiding frequency at 12 weeks
Median change in average voided volume at 12 weeks, 3.9 mg/day versus placebo
Median change in average voided volume at 12 weeks, 2.6 mg/day versus placebo
Incontinence Impact Questionnaire total score at 12 weeks
results.note: Improved with 3.9 mg/day versus placebo; abstract gives no scores.

harms.label: Application-site pruritus
harms.note: 10.8%-16.8% across active doses versus 6.1% with placebo.

harms.label: Dry mouth
harms.note: 7.0% with oxybutynin TDS versus 8.3% with placebo; difference not significant.

delivery.label: Patch application and extension
delivery.value: Patches delivering 1.3, 2.6, or 3.9 mg/day were applied twice weekly during 12 blinded weeks, followed by 12 weeks of open-label dose titration.
